suites.title: KCM Production Email Delivery & Health Agent Test Suite

specs.title: 1. Error classifier correctly identifies permanent vs transient errors
2. Exponential backoff increases monotonically and includes jitter
3. Recipient email addresses are consistently hashed and securely masked
4. Idempotency key generation is deterministic and case-insensitive
5. Webhook signature verifier validates authentic signatures and rejects tampering
6. Email Reliability Agent correctly evaluates live system and generates incident diagnostics
7. Composite provider reports configured status and enforces production boundaries

suites.title: KCM Production Resilience & Graceful Degradation Suite

specs.title: 1. API clients enforce strict timeout and do not hang indefinitely
2. Database offline mode safely falls back to local and in-memory caches
3. Payment webhooks verify HMAC SHA256 signatures and reject tampered payloads
4. Idempotency nonces are deterministic and case-insensitive
5. User emails in logs and receipts are consistently hashed and masked
6. Error classification correctly distinguishes permanent vs transient errors with jittered backoff
7. AI pipeline detects prompt injection and masks sensitive database / API credentials
8. Webhook verifier validates authentic signatures and rejects replay / expired timestamps
9. Composite provider reports configured status and enforces production boundaries
10. HTTP Error codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503) are safely categorized
